name: io.github.GermaniU/comfyui-mcp
title: ComfyUI MCP
description: MCP server that wraps a ComfyUI (SDXL / Wan 2.2) instance for image and short-video generation: txt2img, img2img, txt2video/img2video, and model listing, with a GPU arbiter that shares a 12GB card with an LLM.

environmentVariables.name: COMFYUI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Loopback URL of the ComfyUI engine. Inside a container 127.0.0.1 is the container itself, so point it at the host running ComfyUI (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8188 or the LAN IP).

environmentVariables.name: COMFYUI_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: LAN base URL used to build direct image download links.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Only applies when the container runs in HTTP mode. If set, every HTTP request must carry an Authorization: Bearer header.
